correctness.rationale: For each fixed N>=4 and t>0, expand E_t=sum_n exp(-2tn^2)|F_n|^2 at regular N-gon. Residue frequencies k give the exact Hessian 2(S_k-S_0)/N, with rotation k=0 null. Poisson summation for x^2 exp(-2tx^2) yields leading t^(-5/2) exp[-pi^2/(2N^2t)] (1-cos(2pi k/N)) with prefactor pi^2 sqrt(pi/2)/(2N^3), positive and uniquely weakest k=1,N-1 at small time. Shortest integer in residue k gives large-time factor c_k k^2 exp(-2tk^2) with c_k=2 only at even Nyquist, and the weakest is the highest k=floor(N/2). Nonzero curvatures are positive in both extreme regimes, and continuity forces a tie somewhere intermediate without proving unique crossing. Independent check: Independently summed exact integer residue spectra for N=5,6 and heat times 0.01,0.012,0.15,2; first and highest soft modes exchange. Re-derived both Poisson prefactor and Hessian normalization; these tests corroborate but do not prove all-N statements.
residual_risks: Local at equal-weight regular polygon only, fixed N>=4, sufficiently fine/coarse heat scale; no global optimality or all-scale Hessian sign/unique transition count.
